name: dsh-pace-popups
description: One-install bundle for 知识疆域 (Knowledge Territory): mounts the atlas map, its feeders (crosslens card draw, jiyibi notes), the floating bar, the shared skin, and the optional grasp-probe nudge together. Add this one package to get them all; switch any off in the bar. A dsh bundle (dsh.bundle.patch → cordis.patch.yml).
